dependence_structure_caveat: Network flows in CSE-CIC-IDS2017 exhibit temporal clustering and host burstiness. Uniform independent flow resampling ignores intra-cluster correlation, yielding narrower confidence intervals than block or cluster bootstrap resampling.
p_value_bound_resolution: Reporting p_value: 0.0 is an artifact of finite resampling (B = 1,000). When 0 of 1,000 resamples cross zero, the statistically rigorous bound is p < 1/(B+1) = 0.000999 < 0.001.
